races.display_title: British Stallion Studs EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LORD DU GOUET continued his promising start to his career switched to hurdling when second at Fontwell 4 weeks ago and this looks an excellent opportunity for him to go one better. Eagle Warrior is considered the main threat following a perfectly encouraging first effort over hurdles in a strongly-run contest at Carlisle. Loopy Mag and Order Driven can battle it out for third spot. LORD DU GOUET (FR) EAGLE WARRIOR (IRE) LOOPY MAG (FR)

races.display_title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict: RATEMENOW picked up where he left off in the spring when finding only a handicap debutant too good at Market Rasen on his reappearance and is the percentage call to go one better on the back of a breathing operation. Fourofakind showed more promise than the bare result suggests back from another break at Carlisle on his most recent outing and needs a close look having fallen a long way in the weights, with stable-switcher Je Mr Dawson also of interest. RATEMENOW (IRE) FOUROFAKIND (IRE) JE MR DAWSON (FR)

races.display_title: QuinnBet Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MAX POTENTIAL held every chance when falling at the last on his outing in Irish points in March and, having subsequently been purchased for a whopping £280,000, he makes obvious appeal on his Rules debut, especially with good-value claimer Rian Corcoran in the saddle. Rio Blue is in top hands and also ticks plenty of boxes on paper, so warrants respect, while Yorgunnarock has achieved the most of those with Rules experience as things stand. MAX POTENTIAL RIO BLUE (IRE) YORGUNNAROCK

races.display_title: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: DIAMOND STREET displayed plenty of ability on each of his 2 starts in bumpers last season, scoring on debut at Doncaster prior to finishing a solid fifth at Newbury in March. He has plenty about him physically to suggest he will make his mark over hurdles and he earns the vote. Quickkick 's tendency to pull hard hasn't stopped steady progress to date and he's feared, with Poets Express and Moments In Time another couple of interesting types from bumpers. DIAMOND STREET (IRE) QUICKKICK (IRE) POETS EXPRESS (IRE)

races.verdict: ZACHARY HICKES is the least exposed of these and found further progress when justifying strong market confidence at Wolverhampton 36 days ago. He's up 3 lb but should have more to offer so is fancied to defy the rise with the step up to 2m likely to suit. Tarbat Ness has been in excellent form with 4 wins this year and drew clear at Southwell, so is feared most. ZACHARY HICKES TARBAT NESS SQUIRE DANAGHER

races.display_title: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict: ENACTING shaped very well on recent comeback run and is taken to prove too good for more exposed rivals. Caragio has won twice at this track in recent weeks and moved through the race as if still on a winnable mark when second at Newmarket 18 days ago so is set to prove the biggest danger, while Chalk Mountain will be well suited by a well-run race and can figure if getting the breaks. ENACTING (IRE) CARAGIO (IRE) CHALK MOUNTAIN

races.verdict: CROWN OF CROWNS is a lightly-raced filly who built on debut promise when winning a Southwell novice in October, and whilst she still showed some greenness that day, she's bred to stay well and can make a winning handicap debut. Snooker Mccrew is thriving so is hard to discount, though does have stamina to prove, while Midnight Media looks capable of going well once again. CROWN OF CROWNS SNOOKER MCCREW MIDNIGHT MEDIA

races.display_title: Safer Gambling Week 2026 Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: RHAPSODIC is bound to improve on her debut sixth at Leopardstown last month so Dermot Weld's filly is put forward as the answer with this marked step up in trip holding no fears. Serendipia has plenty of decent efforts to her name so she could be the one to give the selection most to think about on all-weather bow. Blue Nasturtium rounds off the shortlist. RHAPSODIC SERENDIPIA (IRE) BLUE NASTURTIUM (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Rhapsodic (7/4), Blue Nasturtium (7/2), Kimy (4/1), Serendipia (9/2), Essential Comedy (8/1), Kigalienne (12/1), Churchill Gale (50/1), Sierra's Dream (66/1), Dyker Heights (100/1)
